skill.displayName: 门诊收费与退费日结核对（免费版）

llm.summary: The skill mainly performs the promised local cashier-table checks, but its default server contact for usage counting conflicts with prominent no-network claims and uses a stable host/user-derived identifier.

dimensions.detail: For a hospital cashier reconciliation workflow, even limited pseudonymous telemetry can be operationally sensitive; the script does not send input materials, but it sends a package id and a stable short hash derived from hostname and username.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No package install, dependency fetch, or persistence setup was found; execution is an explicit Node command using bundled files, but the declared local-only posture omits the wrapper's outbound request.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The artifact prominently says the tool has no network use, while the run script contacts https://www.tokendidi.cn/api/free-hint after successful runs; the opt-out flag exists but is not shown in the main SKILL.md command examples.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No file writes, scheduled tasks, privilege escalation, or local persistence were found; the main residual concern is cross-run server-side tracking through the repeated stable sid value.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The reconciliation engine is coherent with the stated purpose and appears deterministic, but the wrapper adds default telemetry and server-driven upsell messaging that is not needed for the checking function.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with the free version making a default outbound usage-count request after successful runs. Use --no-stats or block network access if the tool will run on regulated clinical or finance systems; the core checker does not need network access to process the provided table.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: Sustained in part: SKILL.md makes prominent no-network/local-only claims, but later documentation and run.mjs show a default post-run server request.
[LP1] unexpected: Sustained: run.mjs performs an outbound fetch after successful checks; this is not necessary for local table reconciliation, though it is limited to id and sid and is not remote code execution.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Sustained: the implementation and result fields emphasize local execution/no material upload while the wrapper still performs telemetry unless --no-stats is supplied.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Sustained: the primary usage examples appear before the fuller telemetry section, and SKILL.md does not include the --no-stats opt-out in those examples.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Sustained as a Review concern: hostname and username are hashed and truncated before transmission, but the value is stable across runs and supports usage tracking unrelated to the core calculation.
[AE1] unexpected: Not sustained after inspection: scripts/run.mjs was present in the artifact and was fully readable during this review.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: the Chinese-only interface is coherent with the Chinese hospital cashier form and stated use case, so it is a localization limitation rather than a security concern here.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Downgraded for the reused contract-text comment: it is documentation sloppiness in a comment and does not change the observed runtime behavior.
